title: Glossary of race types
covers: Maiden; Handicap; Conditions race; Listed; Group/Grade hierarchy
note: BHA defines Maiden, Handicap and Conditions races and describes the Pattern hierarchy, Group/Grade levels and Listed races. Jurisdiction-specific eligibility details remain scoped.

title: IABRW Article 1 — Recognition and Categorization of Quality Races
note: IFHA provides the international framework for Group/Grade quality-race categorization. Use for hierarchy/category existence, not to collapse regional Group and Grade labels.

title: 馬場状態に関する基礎知識
note: JRA explains turf and dirt course structures and the four-stage JRA track-condition system. Japanese 良 is jurisdiction-specific and is not asserted to be globally identical to every Good category.

title: FAQs — Raceday operations and race planning
covers: Race meeting; Race day/raceday; race programme; abandoned; rescheduled; race times
note: BHA current FAQ uses race meeting/raceday, race programmes, abandoned fixtures and re-scheduled races and explains planned race times.

title: British Horseracing Authority publishes 2027 fixture list
note: BHA published 1,440 scheduled fixtures for 2027 and explicitly names the full fixture list and Premier Racedays.

title: 開催日程 2026
covers: Racing calendar; Programme; Scheduled start time
note: JRA annual schedule exposes meeting dates, daily programmes and published race start times. Use as one authority implementation of calendar/programme concepts.

title: USTA Racing tutorial
covers: Card; Entries list; Results; Post time; race programme
note: USTA organizes entries/results as race cards, publishes approximate post times, results and race-program/card status. Harness-specific implementation supports generic document/time concepts without making US usage globally normative.

title: Stewards reports
note: BHA publishes current Stewards reports and enquiry/report records with racecourse/date context.

title: Entries & Results Abbreviation Codes
covers: Official result; Cancelled; Entries; race/card status
note: USTA distinguishes ENTRIES, RACING IN PROGRESS, RESULTS COMPLETED and CANCELLED; completed means uncancelled races have official results.

title: 海外競馬英和辞典 — 競走
covers: Winner; Dead heat; Photo finish; Demotion; Disqualification; official result terminology
note: JRA's overseas racing dictionary maps racing terms including winner, dead heat, photo finish, demotion, disqualification and official/unofficial result language.

title: 競馬用語辞典 — レース、騎乗技術など
covers: Placing/着順; Inquiry/審議; result adjudication
note: JRA defines 着順 as the confirmed placing and 審議 as official review where placing changes, disqualification or race invalidation may be considered.

title: 降着・失格のルール解説
note: JRA explains current demotion and disqualification standards and the circumstances in which the inquiry lamp is shown.

title: 決勝写真撮影カメラ
note: JRA explains line-scan finish photography and its use by finishing judges to determine order at the finish line.

title: 馬券の種類：はじめての方へ
note: JRA defines 単勝 as selecting the winner and 複勝 as selecting a horse to finish within the applicable placing range; exact place range depends on field size.

title: 馬券のルール
covers: Payout; Pari-mutuel pool operation; betting settlement
note: JRA publishes payout rules and payout-rate calculations for its pool betting system. Use for the generic payout concept and as corroboration for pari-mutuel operation.

title: オッズ
note: JRA defines odds as the approximate payout rate and displays them as a multiple per 100-yen stake; jurisdiction-specific display convention is not made global.

title: ブックメーカー
note: JRA explicitly contrasts pari-mutuel and bookmaking systems and states bookmaker payouts use the odds fixed when the bet was purchased.

title: favorite
note: JRA maps favorite to 一番人気馬. Spelling variants and market-mechanics detail remain handled separately in the label/relation layers.
